visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and glasses, opens a wooden door to reveal a cluttered living room. He smiles excitedly at the camera. Yellow text overlays appear on the screen. (2) The camera pans to show two electric guitars on stands in the living room, with clothes and bags scattered on a sofa in the background. (3) The man stands in the center of the room, gesturing dramatically with his hands while talking. (4) He walks away from the camera and enters a bathroom, closing the wooden door behind him. (5) A table is shown with three plates: yellow noodles, dumplings, and cut fruits (apples and pineapples). (6) The man is shown in the bathroom, applying a clear liquid from a blue pump bottle to his hair, creating thick white lather. He looks into the mirror while scrubbing. (7) Product close-ups show three different MARO shampoo bottles (blue, light blue, and dark blue) against various backgrounds, including an outdoor urban balcony. (8) The man stands back in the room, touching his fluffy hair and holding a blue shampoo bottle toward the camera with a triumphant expression.
